about: Round-11 evaluation set of the sonic detectors (src/sonic.js). 30-s store previews (Deezer, iTunes fallback), analysed by the same chain as the party (tempo.js analyzePcm → sonic.js palette/detectFx). Only extracted numbers and labels are stored, no audio. pos = present throughout the recording, unk = cannot be vouched for in an unknown 30-s window; every other class is known absent. 'train' was used for tuning, 'holdout' once to catch overfitting (three rules were then made stricter), 'blind' was never used to change anything.
